definitions.explanation: An official report or statement made to authorities.
The act of filing taxes or declaring goods at customs.

examples.japanese: {申告|しんこく}{書|しょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To fill out a declaration form.
examples.notes: {申告|しんこく}{書|しょ} = declaration form

notes:
{申告|しんこく} refers to formally reporting or declaring information to an authority. Most commonly encountered in tax and customs contexts.

FORMS:
{申|しん} (state, report) + {告|こく} (tell, announce)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{確定|かくてい}{申告|しんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧ (final tax return, filed annually)
- ⟦{税関|ぜいかん}→税関：04380_zeikan⟧{申告|しんこく} (customs declaration)
- ⟦{所得|しょとく}→所得：09850_shotoku⟧{申告|しんこく} (income declaration)
- {申告|しんこく}{書|しょ} (declaration form)
- {申告|しんこく}{漏|も}れ (failure to report)

TAX CONTEXT:
In Japan, salaried workers usually have taxes withheld by their employer (⟦{年末調整|ねんまつちょうせい}→年末調整：10194_nenmatsuchousei⟧). ⟦{確定|かくてい}{申告|しんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧ is required for the self-employed, those with side income, or those claiming certain deductions.

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧ (serious, grave).
